constraints.name: ck_product_prices_valid_price_period
constraints.sql: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

constraints.name: ck_payment_intents_payment_amounts
constraints.sql: amount > 0 AND refunded BETWEEN 0 AND amount

constraints.name: ck_delivery_windows_window_capacity

constraints.name: ck_stock_balances_sellable_stock

constraints.name: ck_merchant_operating_hours_valid_hours
